    rT_SaltInlet_Voted_DegC := 0.5 * (rT_SaltInlet_DegC_ChB + rT_SaltInlet_DegC_ChC);
    bDegradedInstrumentMode := TRUE;

    IF bHealth_T_Salt_ChA THEN

    ELSIF bHealth_T_Salt_ChB THEN

        IF rTimer_DP_Inv_Discrepancy >= rMAX_DISCREPANCY_TIME_Sec THEN
            IF ABS(rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChA - rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Voted_Bar) > rTOL_DP_Inv_Bar THEN
                bHealth_DP_Inv_ChA := FALSE;
            ELSIF ABS(rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChB - rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Voted_Bar) > rTOL_DP_Inv_Bar THEN
                bHealth_DP_Inv_ChB := FALSE;
            ELSE
                bHealth_DP_Inv_ChC := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_DP_Inv_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (bHealth_DP_Inv_ChA AND bHealth_DP_Inv_ChB) THEN
    rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChA + rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChB);
    bDegradedInstrumentMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_DP_Inv_ChA AND bHealth_DP_Inv_ChC) THEN
    rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChA + rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChC);
    bDegradedInstrumentMode := TRUE;
ELSIF (bHealth_DP_Inv_ChB AND bHealth_DP_Inv_ChC) THEN
    rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Voted_Bar := 0.5 * (rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChB + rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChC);
    bDegradedInstrumentMode := TRUE;
ELSE
    IF bHealth_DP_Inv_ChA THEN
        rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Voted_Bar := rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChA;
    ELSIF bHealth_DP_Inv_ChB THEN
        rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Voted_Bar := rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChB;
    ELSIF bHealth_DP_Inv_ChC THEN
        rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Voted_Bar := rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Bar_ChC;
    ELSE
        rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Voted_Bar := 8.50;
        bDegradedInstrumentMode := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: DIGITAL FILTERING, RATE OF CHANGE & TRANSIENT DERIVATIVE COMPUTATION              *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rT_SaltInlet_Filt_DegC       := rT_SaltInlet_Filt_DegC       + rFilterAlpha * (rT_SaltInlet_Voted_DegC       - rT_SaltInlet_Filt_DegC);
rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar      := rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar      + rFilterAlpha * (rP_SteamOutlet_Voted_Bar      - rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar);
rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC     := rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC     + rFilterAlpha * (rT_SteamOutlet_Voted_DegC     - rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC);
rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Filt_Bar  := rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Filt_Bar  + rFilterAlpha * (rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Voted_Bar  - rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Filt_Bar);
rM_Feedwater_Filt_KgSec      := rM_Feedwater_Filt_KgSec      + rFilterAlpha * (rM_Feedwater_KgSec            - rM_Feedwater_Filt_KgSec);
rM_SaltInlet_Filt_KgSec      := rM_SaltInlet_Filt_KgSec      + rFilterAlpha * (rM_SaltInlet_KgSec            - rM_SaltInlet_Filt_KgSec);
rT_FeedwaterInlet_Filt_DegC  := rT_FeedwaterInlet_Filt_DegC  + rFilterAlpha * (rT_FeedwaterInlet_DegC        - rT_FeedwaterInlet_Filt_DegC);
rT_SaltOutlet_Filt_DegC      := rT_SaltOutlet_Filt_DegC      + rFilterAlpha * (rT_SaltOutlet_DegC            - rT_SaltOutlet_Filt_DegC);
rDNI_Filt_kWm2               := rDNI_Filt_kWm2               + rFilterAlpha * (rDNI_SolarIrradiance_kWm2     - rDNI_Filt_kWm2);
rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_Filt_DegC:= rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_Filt_DegC+ rFilterAlpha * (rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_DegC      - rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_Filt_DegC);
rT_TubeWall_Trans_Filt_DegC  := rT_TubeWall_Trans_Filt_DegC  + rFilterAlpha * (rT_TubeWall_Transition_DegC   - rT_TubeWall_Trans_Filt_DegC);
rT_TubeWall_HotEnd_Filt_DegC := rT_TubeWall_HotEnd_Filt_DegC + rFilterAlpha * (rT_TubeWall_HotEnd_DegC      - rT_TubeWall_HotEnd_Filt_DegC);

(* Real-Time Wall Metal Transient Cooling Gradient dT/dt [deg C/min] *)
IF tScanDeltaTime_Sec > 0.001 THEN
    rCooldownRampRate_DegC_Min := ((rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_Filt_DegC - rPreviousT_Wall_DegC) / tScanDeltaTime_Sec) * 60.0;
    rMaxWallCoolingRate_DegC_Min := rCooldownRampRate_DegC_Min;
    rPreviousT_Wall_DegC := rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_Filt_DegC;
    rPreviousT_Steam_DegC := rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: REAL-TIME THERMODYNAMIC ENGINE, INVENTORY OBSERVER & QUENCH STRESS EVALUATION      *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Ternary Molten Salt Thermo-Physical Properties *)
IF rT_SaltInlet_Filt_DegC > 150.0 THEN
    rSaltDensity_KgM3 := 2090.0 - (0.732 * rT_SaltInlet_Filt_DegC);
    rSaltCp_JkgK := 1560.0 + (0.160 * rT_SaltInlet_Filt_DegC);
ELSE
    rSaltDensity_KgM3 := 1980.0;
    rSaltCp_JkgK := 1584.0;
END_IF;

(* Supercritical Steam Pseudo-Critical Point Calculation: T_pc(P) [deg C] *)
IF rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar >= rP_Supercritical_Min_Bar THEN
    bInSupercriticalMode := TRUE;
    rPseudoCriticalTemp_DegC := 373.95 + 0.457 * (rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar - 220.64);
ELSE
    bInSupercriticalMode := FALSE;
    rPseudoCriticalTemp_DegC := 373.95;
END_IF;

(* Approximate Supercritical Main Steam Enthalpy [kJ/kg] at 250 bar *)
IF rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC > rPseudoCriticalTemp_DegC THEN
    rSteamEnthalpy_Out_kJkg := 3100.0 + (3.15 * (rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC - rPseudoCriticalTemp_DegC)) - (0.85 * (rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar - 250.0));
ELSE
    rSteamEnthalpy_Out_kJkg := 2100.0 + (5.40 * (rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC - 300.0));
END_IF;
rSteamEnthalpy_kJkg := rSteamEnthalpy_Out_kJkg;

(* Subcritical/Supercritical High-Pressure Feedwater Inlet Enthalpy [kJ/kg] *)
rWaterEnthalpy_In_kJkg := (4.186 * rT_FeedwaterInlet_Filt_DegC) + (0.095 * rP_FeedwaterInlet_Bar);
rDeltaEnthalpy_kJkg := rSteamEnthalpy_Out_kJkg - rWaterEnthalpy_In_kJkg;
IF rDeltaEnthalpy_kJkg < 100.0 THEN
    rDeltaEnthalpy_kJkg := 100.0;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time OTSG Absorbed Thermal Power [MWth] *)
rThermalPower_MWth := (rM_Feedwater_Filt_KgSec * rDeltaEnthalpy_kJkg) / 1000.0;

(* Benson OTSG Dynamic Fluid Mass Inventory Observer [kg] *)
(* Synthesized from Distributed Moving-Boundary 3-Zone Density Integration & DP *)
IF rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar > 10.0 THEN
    rEstimatedInventory_Kg := (4500.0 * (rDP_OTSG_Inventory_Filt_Bar / 8.50)) * (1.0 + 0.0015 * (250.0 - rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar)) * (1.0 - 0.0008 * (rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC - 565.0));
    IF rEstimatedInventory_Kg < 500.0 THEN
        rEstimatedInventory_Kg := 500.0;
    ELSIF rEstimatedInventory_Kg > 9000.0 THEN
        rEstimatedInventory_Kg := 9000.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rEstimatedInventory_Kg := 1200.0;
END_IF;

(* Axial Pseudo-Critical Transformation Boundary Tracking [% of tube length] *)
IF rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC > rT_FeedwaterInlet_Filt_DegC THEN
    rAccumulator := (rPseudoCriticalTemp_DegC - rT_FeedwaterInlet_Filt_DegC) / (rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC - rT_FeedwaterInlet_Filt_DegC);
    IF rAccumulator < 0.05 THEN
        rPseudoCriticalPosition_Pct := 5.0;
    ELSIF rAccumulator > 0.95 THEN
        rPseudoCriticalPosition_Pct := 95.0;
    ELSE
        rPseudoCriticalPosition_Pct := rAccumulator * 100.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rPseudoCriticalPosition_Pct := 50.0;
END_IF;

(* Quench Protection: Real-Time Tube Wall Thermal Stress Computation [MPa] *)
rDeltaT_WallAcross_DegC := ABS(rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_Filt_DegC - rT_FeedwaterInlet_Filt_DegC);
rCurrentQuenchStress_MPa := (rThermalStressGain_MPa_K * rDeltaT_WallAcross_DegC) + (rP_FeedwaterInlet_Bar * 0.285);

(* Differential Thermal Expansion between P91 Shell and Inconel Tubes [mm] *)
rOTSG_DifferentialExpansion_mm := (rOTSG_Length_m * ((rAlpha_Shell * (rT_SaltOutlet_Filt_DegC - 20.0)) - (rAlpha_Tube * (rT_TubeWall_Trans_Filt_DegC - 20.0)))) * 1000.0;

(* Anti-Freeze Interlock: Multi-Point Minimum Molten Salt Temperature Evaluation *)
rMinObservedSaltTemp_DegC := rT_SaltOutlet_Filt_DegC;
IF rT_SaltInlet_Filt_DegC < rMinObservedSaltTemp_DegC THEN
    rMinObservedSaltTemp_DegC := rT_SaltInlet_Filt_DegC;
END_IF;
IF rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_Filt_DegC < rMinObservedSaltTemp_DegC THEN
    rMinObservedSaltTemp_DegC := rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_Filt_DegC;
END_IF;

(* Thermal Safety Margin Above Salt Freezing / Crystallization [deg C] *)
rMarginToFreeze_DegC := rMinObservedSaltTemp_DegC - rT_SaltFreeze_Threshold_DegC;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER / STATE OBSERVER RECURSION                                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Format Physical Measurement Innovation Vector rInnovation[6] *)
rInnovation[1] := (rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC - rT_SteamNominal_DegC) - xState_Pred[1];
rInnovation[2] := (rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar  - rP_SteamNominal_Bar)  - xState_Pred[2];
rInnovation[3] := (rT_SaltOutlet_Filt_DegC  - 290.0)                - xState_Pred[3];
rInnovation[4] := (rEstimatedInventory_Kg   - 4500.0)               - xState_Pred[4];
rInnovation[5] := (rCurrentQuenchStress_MPa  - 65.0)                 - xState_Pred[5];
rInnovation[6] := (rMarginToFreeze_DegC     - 68.0)                 - xState_Pred[6];

(* State Estimation Correction Update: x_est = x_pred + L * rInnovation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := xState_Pred[iRow];
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mL_Gain[iRow, iCol] * rInnovation[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Est[iRow] := rAccumulator;
    xState[iRow] := xState_Est[iRow]; (* Bind active state *)
END_FOR;

(* Measured Disturbance Vector dDisturbance[2] *)
dDisturbance[1] := rDNI_Filt_kWm2 - 0.950;
dDisturbance[2] := rT_FeedwaterInlet_Filt_DegC - 245.0;

(* Model Propagation for Time k+1: x_pred = A_d * x_est + B_d * u + E_d * d *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mA_d[iRow, iCol] * xState_Est[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * uControl[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 2 DO
        rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mE_d[iRow, iCol] * dDisturbance[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    xState_Pred[iRow] := rAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT QP SOLVER               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
IF (iStateStep = 60) AND NOT bEmergencyTripActive THEN
    (* Evaluate Quench Stress Soft Barrier Slack *)
    IF xState_Est[5] > 95.0 THEN (* Quench stress > 160 MPa *)
        rQuenchSlack := xState_Est[5] - 95.0;
    ELSE
        rQuenchSlack := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Evaluate Anti-Freeze Margin Barrier Slack *)
    IF xState_Est[6] < -43.0 THEN (* Margin < 25 deg C *)
        rFreezeSlack := -43.0 - xState_Est[6];
    ELSE
        rFreezeSlack := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Projected Gradient Descent Iterations *)
    FOR iIter := 1 TO 5 DO
        (* Compute Cost Gradient w.r.t Control Vector u[4]: grad_J = 2 * B_d^T * Q * x + 2 * R * Delta_u + Barrier *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            rAccumulator := 0.0;
            FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
                rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (mB_d[iRow, iCol] * rWeight_Q[iRow] * xState_Est[iRow]);
            END_FOR;
            (* Control Effort Penalty *)
            rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (rWeight_R[iCol] * (uControl[iCol] - uControl_Prev[iCol]));

            (* Barrier Gradient Projections *)
            IF iCol = 1 THEN (* Salt Valve: boost salt if freeze slack high *)
                rAccumulator := rAccumulator - (rBarrier_Freeze_Weight * rFreezeSlack * 0.082);
            ELSIF iCol = 2 THEN (* Feedwater: cut feed if quench slack high *)
                rAccumulator := rAccumulator + (rBarrier_Quench_Weight * rQuenchSlack * 0.068);
            END_IF;

            rGradient_u[iCol] := rAccumulator;
        END_FOR;

        (* Projected Gradient Step *)
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            uControl_Target[iCol] := uControl[iCol] - (rStepSize_Alpha * rGradient_u[iCol]);

            (* Slew Rate Clamping *)
            IF (uControl_Target[iCol] - uControl[iCol]) > rMaxActuatorSlew_PctPerScan THEN
                uControl[iCol] := uControl[iCol] + rMaxActuatorSlew_PctPerScan;
            ELSIF (uControl_Target[iCol] - uControl[iCol]) < -rMaxActuatorSlew_PctPerScan THEN
                uControl[iCol] := uControl[iCol] - rMaxActuatorSlew_PctPerScan;
            ELSE
                uControl[iCol] := uControl_Target[iCol];
            END_IF;

            (* Absolute Physical Saturation Projection *)
            IF uControl[iCol] < rU_Min[iCol] THEN
                uControl[iCol] := rU_Min[iCol];
            ELSIF uControl[iCol] > rU_Max[iCol] THEN
                uControl[iCol] := rU_Max[iCol];
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Update Control History *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        uControl_Prev[iCol] := uControl[iCol];
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) SEQUENCE ENGINE                            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rStateTimer_Sec := rStateTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;

(* Fast State Transition on Emergency Trips *)
IF bEmergencyTripActive THEN
    IF bAntiFreezeTripActive THEN
        iStateStep := 99; (* EMERGENCY_ANTI_FREEZE_GRAVITY_DUMP *)
    ELSE
        iStateStep := 90; (* EMERGENCY_QUENCH_PROTECT_TRIP *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

CASE iStateStep OF
    0: (* IDLE_COLD_STANDBY *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rSaltFlowControl_Pct := 0.0;
        rFeedwaterControl_Pct := 0.0;
        rAttemperatorSpray_Pct := 0.0;
        rTurbineBypass_Pct := 100.0;
        bRecirculationActive := FALSE;

        (* Electric Trace Heating PID Loop to Maintain Hot Standby *)
        rTraceHeat_Err := rTraceHeat_Target_DegC - rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_Filt_DegC;
        rTraceHeat_Integral := rTraceHeat_Integral + (rTraceHeat_Ki * rTraceHeat_Err * tScanDeltaTime_Sec);
        IF rTraceHeat_Integral > 100.0 THEN rTraceHeat_Integral := 100.0; ELSIF rTraceHeat_Integral < 0.0 THEN rTraceHeat_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;
        rTraceHeatDuty_Pct := (rTraceHeat_Kp * rTraceHeat_Err) + rTraceHeat_Integral;
        IF rTraceHeatDuty_Pct > 100.0 THEN rTraceHeatDuty_Pct := 100.0; ELSIF rTraceHeatDuty_Pct < 0.0 THEN rTraceHeatDuty_Pct := 0.0; END_IF;
        bTraceHeatingActive := (rTraceHeatDuty_Pct > 5.0);

        IF bEnable AND (iTargetOperatingMode >= 1) AND NOT bEmergencyTripActive THEN
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 10; (* Transition to TRACE_HEAT_PREHEAT_SOAK *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    10: (* TRACE_HEAT_PREHEAT_SOAK *)
        (* Enforce metal temperature soak >= 270 °C across all tube wall sensors before salt admission *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rTraceHeatDuty_Pct := 100.0;
        bTraceHeatingActive := TRUE;
        rSaltFlowControl_Pct := 0.0;
        rFeedwaterControl_Pct := 0.0;

        IF (rT_TubeWall_ColdEnd_Filt_DegC >= 270.0) AND
           (rT_TubeWall_Trans_Filt_DegC >= 270.0) AND
           (rT_TubeWall_HotEnd_Filt_DegC >= 270.0) AND
           (rStateTimer_Sec >= 60.0) THEN
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 20; (* Transition to NITROGEN_PURGE_AND_PRESSURE_PROOF *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* NITROGEN_PURGE_AND_PRESSURE_PROOF *)
        (* Purge oxygen and pressurize shell with dry N2 to verify pneumatic integrity *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bOpen_N2PurgeValves := TRUE;
        rTraceHeatDuty_Pct := 50.0;

        IF (rP_NitrogenPurgeSupply_Bar >= 6.0) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 30.0) THEN
            bOpen_N2PurgeValves := FALSE;
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 30; (* Transition to SALT_LOOP_LOW_FLOW_PRIMING *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* SALT_LOOP_LOW_FLOW_PRIMING *)
        (* Establish low-flow molten salt recirculation to equalize casing temperatures *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bRecirculationActive := TRUE;
        rSaltFlowControl_Pct := 15.0; (* 15% priming salt flow *)
        rFeedwaterControl_Pct := 0.0;
        rTurbineBypass_Pct := 100.0;

        IF (rT_SaltOutlet_Filt_DegC >= 280.0) AND (rMarginToFreeze_DegC >= 50.0) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 45.0) THEN
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 40; (* Transition to SUBCRITICAL_FEEDWATER_WARMUP *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* SUBCRITICAL_FEEDWATER_WARMUP *)
        (* Admit conditioned preheated feedwater (T_fw >= 240 °C), ramp pressure to 120 bar *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bRecirculationActive := FALSE;
        rSaltFlowControl_Pct := 25.0;
        rFeedwaterControl_Pct := 20.0;
        rTurbineBypass_Pct := 100.0;

        IF (rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar >= 100.0) AND (rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC >= 320.0) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 60.0) THEN
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 50; (* Transition to SUPERCRITICAL_RAMP_PRESSURIZATION *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* SUPERCRITICAL_RAMP_PRESSURIZATION *)
        (* Pressurize through pseudo-critical threshold (221 bar up to 250 bar) *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rSaltFlowControl_Pct := 45.0 + (0.5 * rStateTimer_Sec);
        IF rSaltFlowControl_Pct > 75.0 THEN rSaltFlowControl_Pct := 75.0; END_IF;

        rFeedwaterControl_Pct := 40.0 + (0.45 * rStateTimer_Sec);
        IF rFeedwaterControl_Pct > 70.0 THEN rFeedwaterControl_Pct := 70.0; END_IF;

        rTurbineBypass_Pct := 60.0;

        IF (rP_SteamOutlet_Filt_Bar >= 245.0) AND (rT_SteamOutlet_Filt_DegC >= 540.0) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 90.0) THEN
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 60; (* Transition to AUTO_SUPERCRITICAL_MPC_DISPATCH *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    60: (* AUTO_SUPERCRITICAL_MPC_DISPATCH *)
        (* Steady-state supercritical power dispatch under full multivariable MPC control *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rSaltFlowControl_Pct   := uControl[1];
        rFeedwaterControl_Pct  := uControl[2];
        rAttemperatorSpray_Pct := uControl[3];
        rTurbineBypass_Pct     := uControl[4];

        (* Cloud Transient Derate Detection *)
        IF (rDNI_Filt_kWm2 < 0.45) OR (rDNI_SolarIrradiance_kWm2 < 0.40) THEN
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 70; (* Transition to SOLAR_CLOUD_TRANSIENT_DERATE *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        IF (iTargetOperatingMode = 6) THEN
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 80; (* Transition to CONTROLLED_RECUPERATIVE_SHUTDOWN *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    70: (* SOLAR_CLOUD_TRANSIENT_DERATE *)
        (* Rapid solar DNI drop: throttle feedwater mass flow to hold inventory without quenching *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rSaltFlowControl_Pct := 50.0;
        rFeedwaterControl_Pct := 35.0;
        rTurbineBypass_Pct := 25.0;

        IF (rDNI_Filt_kWm2 >= 0.70) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 30.0) THEN
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 60; (* Return to AUTO_SUPERCRITICAL_MPC_DISPATCH *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        ELSIF rStateTimer_Sec >= 300.0 THEN
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 80; (* Orderly shutdown after prolonged cloud cover *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    80: (* CONTROLLED_RECUPERATIVE_SHUTDOWN *)
        (* Orderly ramp-down of salt and steam *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rSaltFlowControl_Pct := 15.0;
        rFeedwaterControl_Pct := 10.0;
        rTurbineBypass_Pct := 100.0;

        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 120.0 THEN
            iPreviousState := iStateStep;
            iStateStep := 0; (* Return to IDLE *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    90: (* EMERGENCY_QUENCH_PROTECT_TRIP *)
        (* Thermal shock mitigation: isolate water immediately, open bypass, hold salt recirculation *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rFeedwaterControl_Pct := 0.0;
        bFeedwaterIsolationTrip := TRUE;
        rTurbineBypass_Pct := 100.0;
        rAttemperatorSpray_Pct := 0.0;
        rSaltFlowControl_Pct := 10.0; (* Maintain low-speed salt circulation to avoid hot spots *)

    99: (* CRITICAL_ANTI_FREEZE_GRAVITY_DUMP *)
        (* Immediate SIL-3 gravity dump of molten salt to underground dump tank + N2 blowdown *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDrainCommand := TRUE;
        bOpen_SaltDumpValves := TRUE;
        bClose_SaltIsolationValves := TRUE;
        rSaltFlowControl_Pct := 0.0;
        rFeedwaterControl_Pct := 0.0;
        bFeedwaterIsolationTrip := TRUE;
        rTurbineBypass_Pct := 100.0;

        (* High-Pressure N2 Blowdown Purge Sequencing *)
        rDumpTimer_Sec := rDumpTimer_Sec + tScanDeltaTime_Sec;
        IF (rDumpTimer_Sec >= 2.0) AND (rDumpTimer_Sec <= 20.0) THEN
            bOpen_N2PurgeValves := TRUE;
            bNitrogenPurgeActive := TRUE;
        ELSE
            bOpen_N2PurgeValves := FALSE;
            bNitrogenPurgeActive := FALSE;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: FAST-ACTING SAFETY INTERLOCK MATRIX & TRIP LOGIC                                   *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Quench Protection Thermal Shock Interlock *)
IF (rCooldownRampRate_DegC_Min <= rCoolingRateTrip_DegC_M) OR
   (rCurrentQuenchStress_MPa >= rQuenchStressTrip_MPa) OR
